content:
ida: Saw a tiny spike in SSE reconnects around 03:14 UTC for a handful of tenants. Suspect lease/tombstone race with keepalive jitter.
cho: Any logs?
ida: Short excerpt:
```
[03:14:05] socket: keepalive_recv tenant=foo jitter_ms=180
[03:14:06] lease: tombstone sess=sess-47 ttl_ms=30000
[03:14:06] client: reconnect start conn=new-89
[03:14:07] metering: conn_open tenant=foo
```
console-team: Our sampling for sse.keepalive events is 0.5% and missed most cases; only saw the outliers.
ida: Root cause theory: jitter > tombstone slack -> session tombstoned before reconnect dedupe window, causing double metering.
cho: Quick mitigations: bump sampling to 5% for affected routes for 20m, and temporarily extend dedupe window to 90s for those tenants.
ops-bot: Scheduled: sampling bump at 03:30, auto-revert 20m.
billing-svc: We can add a reconnect_tag=\"fast_reconn\" on quick reconnect path and adjust metering to ignore token charge if tag present and within dedupe window. Requires a small proto change but doable as opt-in.
ida: Longer-term: introduce a post_keepalive_hold_ms (150ms) that delays tombstone if a reconnect from same client_ip/token is observed. Config sketch:
```
ws:
  post_keepalive_hold_ms: 150
metering:
  reconnect_dedupe_ms: 60000
```
cho: Tests: unit test for hold window, integration with simulated jittered clients, and end-to-end metering check.
console-team: Also add a short-lived alert: metering.duplicate_tokens.count > 3/min -> page on-call (first occurrence).
ida: Plan: implement hold flag behind feature flag sse_keepalive_hold_v1, roll 0.1% -> 1% -> 10% -> 100%, monitor ws.reconnect.count and metering.duplicate_tokens.count.
cho: Action items:
- ida: PR for post_keepalive_hold + tests
- billing-svc: proto change for reconnect_tag and dedupe logic (RFC)
- console-team: sampling bump + alert
ops-bot: Deploy routing:feature/keepalive-hold -> staging at 04:20. CI green.
ida: If anyone sees >5 reconnects/min after canary, call it out here and we'll rollback. :thumbsup:
